purpose: Source-level inventory for Tier-B idiolect calibration. Raw prose is intentionally excluded from Git.
primary_written_corpus_rule: Only natural-owner-confirmed written samples are eligible for the primary Joel written profile. Spoken material is modeled separately.
normalization_rules: Preserve authored wording, punctuation, casing, paragraph boundaries, contractions, misspellings, and ordinary author-created headings unless a separate experiment explicitly tests normalization.

Remove Blogger/Substack/editor chrome, share controls, timestamps repeated by the platform, navigation labels, embed debris, and raw URLs while preserving author-written anchor text where recoverable.
Remove email addresses, phone numbers, access tokens, tracking parameters, and other contact/credential-like strings from modeling text.
Remove or separately mark substantial quotations from other authors; quoted text must not become Joel-style training data.
For discussion/Q&A pages, retain only Joel-authored turns. Interlocutor text may be retained outside the model corpus as context metadata, never as Joel prose.
Mirrors, reposts, duplicated exports, and near-duplicate versions belong to one near_duplicate_group and may never cross profile/validation/test boundaries.
Split by independent source/post/thread, never by random paragraphs from the same source.
For mixed-provenance documents, segment by known authorship provenance; never infer human authorship solely from an AI detector.
